# Lufia Design System

> Accessible, themeable React 19 components, design tokens and motion primitives (@lufia/design-system). Styled with CSS Modules over `--lufia-*` semantic tokens, safe for Server Components, with every user-facing string passed in as a prop.

The package is pre-1.0 and not on npm yet: consuming apps install from a git tag. Components carry a status (alpha, beta, stable); read it before relying on an API. Import each component from its own subpath, for example `@lufia/design-system/components/Button`.

## Start here

- [Consuming the package](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/CONSUMING.md): install, theme setup, provider, RSC rules, conventions.
- [llms-full.txt](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/llms-full.txt): this index with the consuming guide, motion rules and every component spec inlined.
- [components.json](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/components.json): machine-readable manifest generated from the TypeScript types (props, types, defaults, status, a11y, story ids).
- [agent-index.md](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/agent-index.md): every component with its import path, status and key props in under 8 KB, to paste into a consuming app's AGENTS.md.
- Version-matched lookup: the installed package ships these docs; run `npx --no-install lufia-ai search "task"` or `npx --no-install lufia-ai mcp` (see the consuming guide).
- [Storybook](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/): live examples, theme and viewport controls.

## Components: Actions

- [ActionIcons](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/ActionIcons.md): Deprecated aliases of six action icons; use the named icons of Icon instead. (deprecated)
- [Button](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Button.md): The control for an action: a native button, or a link that looks like one. (beta)
- [IconButton](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/IconButton.md): A button with only an icon, which therefore requires an accessible name. (beta)
- [Link](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Link.md): Navigation inside text, routed through the adapter set on LufiaProvider. (beta)
- [MoreActions](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/MoreActions.md): An overflow menu that collects the secondary actions of a row or a page. (beta)
- [PageActions](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/PageActions.md): The action bar of a page: one primary action, the rest collapsed on narrow screens. (beta)

## Components: Forms

- [Checkbox](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Checkbox.md): A checkbox with a mixed state, for independent on/off choices. (beta)
- [Combobox](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Combobox.md): A searchable single-select dropdown input with async options, following the APG combobox pattern. (beta)
- [DateField](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/DateField.md): A native date, time, date-and-time or month control in the shared field box, with icon and optional clear button. (beta)
- [DateRangeField](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/DateRangeField.md): Two date fields that form one range, in a fieldset, with the start held at or before the end. (beta)
- [FileField](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/FileField.md): A file picker with drag and drop, validation and a list of chosen files. (beta)
- [FormField](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/FormField.md): Label, hint and error wired to any control, so the control stays accessible by default. (beta)
- [PendingSubmit](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/PendingSubmit.md): A submit button that reads the pending state of its form and prevents double submits. (beta)
- [RadioGroup](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/RadioGroup.md): A set of radios where exactly one choice applies. (beta)
- [SearchInput](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/SearchInput.md): A search field with a clear button, optional debounce and a shortcut hint. (beta)
- [SegmentedToggle](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/SegmentedToggle.md): A compact single-choice control for switching between a few views or modes. (beta)
- [Select](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Select.md): A native select (dropdown) styled with tokens, for choosing one option from a short list. (beta)
- [Switch](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Switch.md): An on/off control whose change takes effect immediately. (beta)
- [TextInput](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/TextInput.md): A single-line text field with optional prefix and suffix. (beta)
- [Textarea](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Textarea.md): A multi-line text field that can show a character count. (beta)

## Components: Overlays

- [CommandPalette](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/CommandPalette.md): A keyboard-first launcher that filters commands and pages. (beta)
- [ConfirmDialog](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/ConfirmDialog.md): A modal question that has to be answered, with a destructive variant. (beta)
- [Modal](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Modal.md): A dialog that interrupts the page and traps focus until it is dismissed. (beta)
- [NotificationCenter](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/NotificationCenter.md): A bell with an unread count that opens a panel of notifications: a popover on wide pages, a sheet on narrow ones. (beta)

## Components: Navigation

- [AppShell](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/AppShell.md): The application frame: sidebar, content area and the phone navigation sheet. (beta)
- [NavRow](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/NavRow.md): A row that links to a destination, for lists of places and settings. (beta)
- [PageHeader](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/PageHeader.md): The title row of a page with eyebrow, description and actions. (beta)
- [Pagination](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Pagination.md): Previous, next and numbered pages for long lists. (beta)
- [PeerNav](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/PeerNav.md): Links or tabs for moving between sibling views of the same page. (beta)
- [SectionHeader](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/SectionHeader.md): The title row of one section of a page: heading, description and actions. (beta)
- [Stepper](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Stepper.md): Shows progress through a short, ordered flow. (beta)

## Components: Data display

- [ActivityList](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/ActivityList.md): A feed of what happened with its time, optionally on a timeline rail. (beta)
- [AttentionList](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/AttentionList.md): A short list of items that need a decision, with a tone bar and an action. (beta)
- [Badge](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Badge.md): A short status or count label in a semantic tone. (beta)
- [BarList](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/BarList.md): Horizontal bars with the name and the value as text, on one shared scale. (beta)
- [BulletBar](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/BulletBar.md): A value as a bar against a target tick, comparable across rows. (beta)
- [Card](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Card.md): A bordered surface that groups related content, optionally interactive. (beta)
- [ColumnChart](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/ColumnChart.md): Columns on one baseline, single or stacked, with the numbers in a hidden data table. (beta)
- [DetailAttentionCard](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/DetailAttentionCard.md): A high-signal card for deadlines and risk, with a tone mark and an optional action. (beta)
- [DetailList](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/DetailList.md): Label and value pairs for the details of one record. (beta)
- [DetailSectionCard](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/DetailSectionCard.md): A titled card that holds one section of a detail page. (beta)
- [ProgressBar](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/ProgressBar.md): A determinate progress bar with a native progressbar role. (beta)
- [QueueSummary](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/QueueSummary.md): Work queues by urgency: open ones as rows, empty ones folded into one line, an all-clear when none are open. (beta)
- [SortableTh](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/SortableTh.md): A table header cell that sorts a column and announces the order. (beta)
- [Sparkline](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Sparkline.md): A word-sized trend chart with no axes, drawn in SVG. (beta)
- [StackedBar](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/StackedBar.md): One bar split into proportional segments, with a legend and a text alternative. (beta)
- [StatTile](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/StatTile.md): A key figure with its label, change and hint, optionally a link to its detail. (beta)
- [StatusTimeline](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/StatusTimeline.md): A vertical timeline of states with their dates. (beta)
- [TableToolbar](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/TableToolbar.md): The search, filter and action row above a table. (beta)

## Components: Feedback

- [Banner](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Banner.md): An inline message for a page or section: info, success, warning, danger or neutral, with an optional action and dismiss. (beta)
- [EmptyState](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/EmptyState.md): What to show when a list or panel has nothing yet, with the one next step. (beta)
- [SkeletonCard](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/SkeletonCard.md): A loading card: title bar, text lines and an optional block in the card's padding. (beta)
- [SkeletonPageHeader](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/SkeletonPageHeader.md): The top of a loading page, on PageHeader's own layout and breakpoints. (beta)
- [SkeletonTable](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/SkeletonTable.md): Placeholder rows for a loading table: equal columns, bars inside their cells, stacked on narrow widths. (beta)
- [StatusIcon](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/StatusIcon.md): One family of status markers, each tone with its own shape so it reads without colour. (beta)
- [SuccessCheck](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/SuccessCheck.md): An animated check mark for a completed action. (beta)
- [Toast](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Toast.md): A transient message that confirms an action without taking focus. (beta)

## Components: Motion

- [AnimatedNumber](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/AnimatedNumber.md): Counts a number to its new value and respects reduced motion. (beta)
- [ChangeHighlight](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/ChangeHighlight.md): Briefly highlights content that changed, so the change is noticed. (beta)
- [Collapse](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Collapse.md): Animates the height of content that opens and closes. (beta)
- [Reveal](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Reveal.md): Fades and lifts content in as it enters, once. (beta)
- [RouteTransition](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/RouteTransition.md): Fades the content region in when the page changes, with no router dependency. (beta)
- [Skeleton](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Skeleton.md): A placeholder with the shape of the content that is loading. (beta)
- [Stagger](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Stagger.md): Children that enter one after another, capped in length and still under reduced motion. (beta)

## Components: Utilities

- [ChartKit](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/ChartKit.md): Colour of a chart mark. The tone only reinforces: the value is always printed as text next to the drawing, so a tone is never the only carrier of meaning (WCAG 1.4.1). (beta)
- [Icon](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/Icon.md): The icon set: named stroke icons on one 24-unit grid, the Icon primitive and createIcon for an app's own glyphs. (beta)
- [LufiaProvider](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/LufiaProvider.md): Sets the link adapter and the aria-only labels once, at the root of an app. (beta)
- [VisuallyHidden](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/VisuallyHidden.md): Hides text visually and keeps it for assistive technology. (beta)

## Components: Hooks

- [useBodyScrollLock](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/useBodyScrollLock.md): Locks page scrolling while an overlay is open, without layout shift. (beta)
- [useDismiss](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/useDismiss.md): Calls back on Escape or an outside press, for popovers and menus. (beta)
- [useFocusTrap](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/useFocusTrap.md): Keeps Tab inside a container and restores focus when it closes. (beta)
- [useMediaQuery](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/useMediaQuery.md): Subscribes a component to a CSS media query, safe for server rendering. (beta)
- [useModalState](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/useModalState.md): Open, close and the element to return focus to, for a controlled modal. (beta)
- [usePagination](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/usePagination.md): Computes the page range with ellipses for a paginator. (beta)
- [usePrefersReducedMotion](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/usePrefersReducedMotion.md): Reads the reduced-motion preference, for code that animates in JavaScript. (beta)
- [useSlidingIndicator](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/useSlidingIndicator.md): Measures the active item so an indicator can slide to it. (beta)
- [useStepDirection](https://luizgabriellf.github.io/lufia-design-system/ai/components/useStepDirection.md): Tells a stepper whether it is moving forward or back. (beta)

## Docs

- [Standards checklist](https://github.com/luizgabriellf/lufia-design-system/blob/main/docs/STANDARDS.md): What every component must meet: tokens, a11y, API conventions, status labels.
- [Motion rules](https://github.com/luizgabriellf/lufia-design-system/blob/main/docs/MOTION.md): Motion principles, tokens, reduced-motion policy and the lufia-verify-motion CLI.
